title: panic - LinkAccountData
body:
### Description

Hey!

Thanks for the project.
I am not sure how to reproduce the bug.
The site was showing me 500 error, then ssh-ed in server and found following `panic` logs.
The panic was gone when I cleared my session/cookie data and logged in again. It's all working now again.
